dct_title_s: Plan of the city of Washington
dct_description_sm: Coordinates approximate and based on Greenwich meridian.
Shows city plan, including "Presidents house" and "Capitol."
French military engineer and architect Major Pierre Charles L'Enfant was invited by George Washington to lay out the new capital for the United States.
Tooley's dictionary of mapmakers E-J: 14; K-P: 118; Q-Z: 260.
Jolly, D.C. Maps of America in periodicals before 1800, 441.
Published in the Universal asylum, and Columbian magazine, v. 4, March 1792.
